constrained_surface_update.model: SSVI with phi(theta) = eta / sqrt(theta * (1 + theta)); shared rho and eta, monotone linear ATM variance with theta(0)=0.
constrained_surface_update.scope: Optional single-date fit and Dupire diagnostics through the existing validation command. No historical hedge runner or strategy changed.
constrained_surface_update.constraints: Strict eta^2(1+abs(rho)) < 4 and abs(rho) < 1 satisfy the sufficient butterfly conditions; monotone theta and the selected phi satisfy the calendar condition.
constrained_surface_update.derivative_policy: Analytical strike derivatives; one-sided expiry derivatives; no maturity extrapolation after the last fitted expiry. Wings and the origin-to-first-expiry interval are modeled, not new quote support.
constrained_surface_update.input_policy: Every checked original source midpoint is fitted in original half-spread units; quote and carry values are not altered.

volatility_comparison_notebook_update.quote_policy: All quotes enter the original half-spread price-error summaries. Invalid midpoint IVs are omitted only from IV plots, with counts reported. AH smile lines connect saved fitted-price IVs at quoted strikes.
volatility_comparison_notebook_update.pin_policy: Validation output checksums are checked. The optional AH model is loaded from a study with matching frozen quote and carry input digests; immutable files are checked while the live index may advance.

comparison_3d_notebook_update.scope: Same-date six-panel 3D comparison: quote-PCHIP IV, AH price-implied IV, SSVI IV, quote-PCHIP Dupire local volatility, recovered AH local volatility and SSVI Dupire local volatility.
comparison_3d_notebook_update.grid_policy: Shared normalized-strike and maturity grids. Strike range is the union of quoted ranges within the AH interior domain. Pillars and nearby times are included; exact pillars use left-hand time derivatives.
comparison_3d_notebook_update.rendering_policy: Shared height limits within each row. Local-volatility height is logarithmic by default, with percentage ticks; optional linear mode. Only cells with four available corners are rendered. Invalid states stay missing and positive extremes remain uncapped.
